purpose: Six-slice development pilot of the two feasible source-excerpt prompts: the same predeclared 12 pilot questions, identical hybrid/10/title0/RRF50 contexts, one local attempt per question and arm. This broadens beyond the five-case feasibility to exact identifiers, more comparisons and two absence cases. Both prompts run on the current export-style-verified runtime.
continuation_gate: Review all outputs, complete facts/qualifications, misleading selection, actual export content, failures and all six slices. Continue to the full paired 42-question comparison only for useful candidates with no critical unsupported/misleading source failure. Repeated feasibility IDs are part of a predeclared balanced new-version pilot, not retries or replacements; retain all earlier outcomes. Do not select on pilot results or use the final set.
revision_rationale: Source-excerpt feasibility produced complete supported comparisons (3/5 concise, 4/5 complete), zero output errors and zero critical answers, but both missed an available design qualification. The intervening code change binds answer-style metadata and original prose at replay/export boundaries; prompt messages and source selection semantics are unchanged. Native browser QA used one separate EXA-01 call, never included as an arm success.
